name: Windfarm ontology (designated areas and wind turbines)
abstract: Shared ontology for wind farms as designated areas and for individual wind turbines, used by the common-windfarm-designated-area and common-windfarm-turbine building blocks. It aligns EMODnet Human Activities, OpenStreetMap, IHO S-100 and national (NVE, Polish) source properties, with SKOS concept schemes for status, country, rotor axis, source type and location status.
